title: Move one workload, then retire its old owner
subtitle: Desired cross-cluster cutover: one data writer and one network authority at each step.
note: An illustrative rehearsal, not a performed migration. Source backend, boot identity and data consistency must be inventoried.

boxes.kicker: ROLLBACK CHANGES AT THE ACCEPTED-WRITE BOUNDARY
lines: Before target writes: rehearsed reversal. After target writes: data reconciliation and authority transfer.
No OpenStack-to-qrab live migration or automatic cross-cluster address transfer is assumed.
